name: PNB RuPay Platinum Vaibhav Debit Card
description: PNB RuPay Platinum Vaibhav Debit Card is a PNB RUPAY PLATINUM VAIBHAV from Punjab National Bank. International usage; ATM limit Rs. 50,000/day, PoS/eCom limit Rs. 150,000/day. NCMC offline transit enabled. Valid 7 years.
tagline: RuPay Platinum debit card from PNB — international usage with NCMC transit.

benefits.title: Personal Accidental Insurance Cover
benefits.description: Personal Accident Insurance cover (Accidental Death or Permanent Total Disability) of upto Rs. 2,00,000/-. benefits.title: Airport Lounge Access
benefits.description: Domestic Airport lounge program for RuPay Platinum Debit Card provides access to cardholders Two (2) times per calendar year per card in any of the participating Domestic Airport lounges. For updated lounge list, refer to NPCI RuPay Website

features: Can be used at all POS terminals, E Com Websites / Apps and ATMs across India

notes: Either Senior Citizen or Pensioners or both maintaining Monthly Average Balance of Rs.50,000/- or above and account opened under eligible schemes.
